in_marathi.name: Manirul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manirul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manirul is derived from two words: Mani, meaning moon, and Rul, meaning ruler or king. In Hindu mythology, Manirul is a name associated with the moon deity, Chandra, who is known to rule the night sky.
